brief.subject: Bills due before payday? Try moving the due date
brief.headline: Bills Due Before Payday? Moving the Due Date Can Ease the Squeeze
brief.dek: Asking to shift bill due dates can smooth cash flow, and two Atmos Rewards cards raised welcome offers to as much as 100,000 points.
brief.lede: If bills land before your paycheck, asking billers to change your due dates can ease the timing crunch.

sections.heading: Fixing the payday timing gap
bullets: Bills due before payday are a common cash-flow problem for households living check to check.
Requesting a new due date from billers can line payments up with when money actually arrives.
Better-aligned dates can reduce the scramble to cover bills before income hits your account.

sections.heading: Atmos cards raise welcome offers
bullets: Up to 100,000 points: Atmos Rewards Ascent Visa Signature and Summit Visa Infinite cards boosted their welcome offers.
The two cards' offers differ, so weigh annual costs and terms before chasing a bigger bonus.
